description: Note: automatic Undo is off by default. On Education 1.26.x, once it is on, the native check before the first build makes the game command channel stop responding for good (the player's typing gets no response either) until Minecraft is restarted; configure enabled=true only when the user explicitly asks for it. action=status only reads the automatic Undo state and timings; configure turns it on or off and sets the block budget (default 4096, max 32768); same-material ranges are saved as whole regions and compared with native region checks. clear releases this server's backups. Backups live only in game memory, with no disk backup and no Redo. Turning automatic backup off clears the old history.
name: mc_undo_control
title: View or configure one-step undo
